comments.comment: DIP-04: automatic diplomacy factory maps work codes 33/34/35/36 to gift, attack-request, prisoner-return, and surrender-demand action objects.
DIP-04: primary-force batch 0 orders diplomacy work as gift(33), surrender(36), prisoner return(35), attack request(34), interleaved with non-diplomacy work.
DIP-04: each non-null child is queued and awaited before the cursor advances, so later planners observe state changed by earlier children.
DIP-04: attack-request planning may skip on a force-context bit-8 plus 50-percent gate, then builds requested-force, target-building, and envoy candidates.
DIP-04: temporary attack-request command advisor mapping is 0/2->50, 1->100, 3->0, default->free-acceptance threshold; feasible score is at least 20.
DIP-04: prisoner-return planning ranks prisoners by 460*max(current abilities)+sum(current abilities), then selects an eligible envoy.
DIP-04: prisoner-return advisor result 0 uses min(rnd(max current ability + 20),100); results 1/2/3 map to 100/50/0; feasible score is at least 20.
DIP-04: surrender planning rejects force-context bit-8 sources and keeps targets whose associated 7-bit metric is lower than the source metric.
DIP-04: surrender advisor mapping is result 1->100, 3->0, otherwise actual acceptance threshold; feasible value is at least 33.
